hero.title: Hi, I’m Anya Ansu
hero.text: I guide breathwork and somatic practices for more clarity, rest, and connection with the body.

about.title: A soft space for returning to yourself
about.lead: I am a breathwork and somatic facilitator. My work brings together breathing, body awareness, and gentle exploration of inner states.
about.text: I came to these practices through my own need — learning to listen to the body, return to myself, and find support within. Over time, this experience became something I wanted to share gently with others.

work.title: Through the body, we can hear what has been asking for attention
work.subtitle: The practices focus on the nervous system, breath, inner support, and restoring contact with yourself.

items.quote: The experience was deep, profound, and liberating. I had a strong emotional and physical release. The theme, the music, Anya’s soft voice — all the elements married perfectly together. Anya created a safe space for me to fully immerse in my experience, and I felt her support and guidance throughout the whole session.
items.author: Practice participant

items.quote: It was excellent. I loved that she picked her own theme and shared the context behind it. She also took time to explain everything in detail before the session and checked if I had any questions or concerns. I would love to do it again.
items.author: Practice participant

items.quote: I really loved the breathwork session with Anya. All the necessary instructions were given before the session, and then the journey started. Anya’s voice guided me through the practice: I never felt lost, and at the same time there was just the right amount of voice, so I could fully focus on my own experience. The music choice was brilliant, helping me breathe and creating the whole atmosphere. After the session, I felt very relaxed, slowed down, smiling, and trusting life and myself. This should be an everyday practice. Thank you, Anya!
items.author: Practice participant

items.quote: My attitude toward breathwork practices shifted even more in a positive direction thanks to Anya. Before, I would mostly calm my overstimulated mind with box breathing or open the diaphragm, but this time I could use my imagination and visit a magical forest, where everything around me felt like Avatar, and I walked there with my younger self. After the practice, the sensations were very warm and enveloping. I am deeply grateful to Anya for that walk, and I want to try different practices because I could still feel the effect for two or three days. The half-hour practice flew by in one moment. Anya also has a beautiful voice and a very good musical background.
items.author: Anna

items.quote: Everything was wonderful. I felt a huge wave of gratitude. I especially want to thank the facilitator for the thoughtful behind-the-scenes preparation: the playlist and the story that guided us through the whole session. These things can often go unnoticed, but they require a lot of work, energy, and care. I really appreciated the detailed briefing before the session: all the possible effects, different scenarios, and what to do in different situations. We could try the breathing pattern beforehand, clarify anything unclear, and ask questions. I loved the music — it helped me go to the right level of depth.
items.author: Tatiana

items.quote: I liked that I had more energy afterward. I had a slight headache before the practice, and after it the headache was almost gone. Overall, my mind and awareness felt clearer. I also liked that the music matched the cycles and helped me keep the rhythm.
items.author: Olga

items.quote: The breathwork practice was a discovery for me. I felt a deep relaxation and peace that I had not experienced for a long time. The voice guidance was very pleasant and gave me goosebumps. During the session, I felt as if I had immersed myself in a deep ocean of calm. Anya guided the session beautifully: I was able to release accumulated tension and anxiety. After the practice, I felt renewed and full of energy. It feels like an incredible tool for self-healing and personal growth.
items.author: Victoria

items.quote: Thank you. I remember how thoughtfully everything was prepared: the care, the notes, blankets, masks, mats, attention, and tea at the end. I also remember your voice during the meditation — its special depth and magic. It was my first experience, and I would be interested in entering it again.
items.author: Polina

items.quote: The state I felt after the practice can truly be called resourceful. I was surprised by how easily, thanks to your consistent and gentle guidance and resonant playlist, I could access energy that seemed completely gone after a very difficult week. The realization that we are constantly surrounded by an enormous amount of resources, the insight about emptiness, and the self-soothing technique became a kind of magical, complex answer to the questions that are alive for me now.
items.author: Maria

items.quote: I was surprised that the practice had such an energizing tone. It broke my stereotype that breathing is only about relaxation. It was a very pleasant 20 minutes, after which I felt a kind of euphoria, magic inside the body, as if the mind had cleared itself from noise for something new. I did the practice late in the evening and found myself already awake in the morning.
items.author: Ulyana

items.quote: Anya, thank you so much for the practice. I really liked it. You created a beautiful atmosphere where I was able to relax. I will repeat it with the recording.
items.author: Maria

items.quote: Anya, I have just done the breathwork session. What you do is incredibly useful. Toward the end of the practice, besides feeling emotionally relaxed and energized in my body, several important insights came to me. Thank you!
items.author: Practice participant

items.quote: Thank you! It was wonderful. I can already feel that I will sleep well.
items.author: Practice participant

items.quote: Anya, your sessions are practically the only time when I have enough inner resource to feel full. I do not need to fill myself with something from the outside in order to feel calm. Thank you so much for this.
items.author: Katerina

items.quote: Anya, dear, I fell asleep instantly after yesterday’s session — I was able to relax so deeply. Thank you so much. It seems that breathing on Sundays really is perfect. Today I feel as productive as possible.
items.author: Maria

items.quote: I am a simple person: when I feel my stress going through the roof, I turn on Anya’s breathwork practices. It is the best way to calm down and sleep normally at night, even though I usually struggle with insomnia.
items.author: Taya

products.title: Practices for self-guided and individual work
products.intro:
Here you’ll find practices and support formats to help you slow down, return to the body, and feel more inner steadiness — on your own, in a group,
or through individual work.

items.title: Breathwork practice library
items.text: A collection of audio and video practices for different states: rest, energy, clarity, and recovery.
items.detail:
A library for self-guided practice at your own pace. You can return to the recordings through different seasons, choosing shorter daily support or deeper sessions for inner exploration.
Coming soon!

items.title: Online group “Alive breathwork”
items.text: Regular group gatherings with breathwork practice, intention setting, and integration.
items.detail: An online group for people who want rhythm, support, and live facilitation. Each meeting includes arrival, breathwork, a soft closing, and space for integration.

items.title: Free breathwork recording for balance
items.detail:
A gentle 6-minute breathwork practice for balance and grounding.
Using box breathing and guided visualization, this session helps calm the mind, regulate the nervous system, and reconnect you with a sense of inner stability and presence.

items.title: Free somatic recording for inner support
items.detail: A somatic audio session for bringing attention back to the body and sensing inner support. It works well as a soft self-practice during the day.

items.title: Individual breathwork session
items.text: A personal breathwork session shaped around your request, with preparation, facilitation, and integration.
items.detail: A one-to-one session supports gentle exploration of a personal request through breath and body connection. We set the context before the practice and leave space for grounding and integration after.

items.title: Individual somatic session
items.text: Gentle one-to-one work through body awareness, the nervous system, and internal resources.
items.detail: A session for slowing down, listening to the body, and finding a steadier way to be with experience. The work is gentle and resource-oriented.
